display_name: Password guessing at scale: spot it
description: An awareness episode of about 8 minutes for all staff, on the defending side only. A password-guessing campaign has hit Merrin & Sallow Architects, a fictional practice, and the alerts are arriving: a lockout, a sign-in alert, a breach warning, some genuine and some fakes. Each answer is explained, and reporting when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down. No real password is ever typed.
